paraphrase: Conditional on the affirmative report, if being concrete ordinarily entails P, then being concrete-and-necessary nontrivially entails being concrete and so P, for any P. The source uses the ordinary concrete-to-P antecedent to license the nontrivial concrete-and-necessary-to-P conclusion. This is a cross-kind transfer commitment, not ordinary conjunction strengthening, a rule whose antecedent already requires NT, or a proved law of every entailment relation.
